name: Galaxy M13

images.credit: Грицик Владислав, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy M14, Samsung Galaxy M14 5G

Network.Technology: M13: GSM / HSPA / LTE, M13 5G: GSM / HSPA / LTE / 5G NR

Platform.Chipset: M13: Samsung Exynos 850 (8nm), M13 5G: MediaTek MT6833 Dimensity 700 (7 nm)
Platform.CPU: M13: Octa-core (4x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55 & 4x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55), M13 5G: Octa-core (2x2.2 GHz Cortex-A76 & 6x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55)

Display.Display: M13: 6.6 in, M13 5G: 6.5 in, All: Infinity-U Display, resolution, 20:9 aspect ratio (~266 ppi density), PLS LCD

Cameras.Rear camera: M13: 50 MP, f/1.8, (wide), PDAF, 5 MP, f/2.2, 123˚ (ultrawide), 2 MP, f/2.4, (depth), M13 5G: 50 MP, f/1.8, (wide), PDAF, 2 MP, f/2.4, (depth), Both: LED flash, panorama, HDR, 1080p@30fps
Cameras.Front camera: M13: 8 MP, f/2.2, (wide), M13 5G: 5 MP, f/2.0, (wide), Both: 1080p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, hotspot, Bluetooth 5.0, A2DP, LE, A-GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BDS
